candidates.content_text:
We are seeking a Civil Drafter to join our growing Buildings team in Brisbane. Reporting to the Civil Team Lead, you will work closely with engineers, designers and multidisciplinary project teams to deliver civil drafting solutions across a diverse portfolio of building projects across Queensland.
Our Buildings team delivers projects across a broad range of sectors including health, education, defence, multi-residential, retail and commercial developments. You will contribute to projects ranging from boutique developments through to large, complex and landmark facilities that have a lasting impact on the communities we serve.
As a Civil Drafter, you will prepare high-quality drawings and design documentation that support the successful delivery of building projects, ensuring outputs meet project requirements, company standards and relevant authority requirements. Working alongside experienced engineers, designers and technical specialists, you'll play an important role in developing coordinated, practical and buildable civil design solutions.
Our culture has a strong focus on learning, personal development and collaboration. You'll be supported by experienced professionals who are passionate about mentoring and helping individuals grow their technical and professional capabilities.
Day to day tasks would involve:
- Prepare civil engineering documentation for building and site development projects using established drafting standards and procedures.
- Operate CAD and other drafting software to produce plans, sections, details and coordinated civil documentation.
- Collaborate with engineers, designers and multidisciplinary project teams to deliver accurate and coordinated design packages.
- Ensure drawings comply with applicable standards, project requirements and quality procedures.
- Assist with managing drawing registers and project deliverables.
- Identify and resolve drafting and coordination issues to support efficient project delivery.
- Deliver project outcomes within client specifications and expectations
To be successful for this role you'll need:
- Tertiary qualification in Computer Aided Design or relevant experience
- Minimum of 2 years of drafting experience in an engineering consultancy as a civil drafter
- Familiarity with local authority and state government approval and regulatory requirement
- Experience in the operation of software design tools such as AutoCAD packages
- Experience producing civil drafting documentation for buildings, site development or infrastructure projects.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail and a strong focus on the production of quality outputs
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ongoing commitment to professional development through self-study, training and seminars, and maintaining your Continual Professional Development (CPD)
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality technical documentation.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
What we offer
- Along with a competitive salary we offer many other benefits to ensure your professional development & wellbeing is ongoing.
- Genuine Flexible Working Arrangements - Including work from home opportunities, provision for school term contracts, job sharing and part-time employment.
- Option to purchase up to 4 weeks additional leave.
- Learning and Talent Development Programs - Including Global programmes, online learning and on-the-job learning
- Mentoring for your own development and the opportunity to mentor others
- A friendly team environment, with dedicated and enthusiastic staff committed to producing high quality service and deliverables
- Professional Memberships
- Salary Continuance Insurance (SCI)
- Mental Health and Wellbeing Programs
- Service Recognition Awards
- Employee Assistance Program
About us
The Stantec community unites approximately 34,000 employees working in over 450+ locations across six continents. We collaborate across disciplines and industries to bring water, transport and infrastructure projects to life. Our work from initial project concept and planning through design, construction and commissioning is built on a nearly 200-year history. So, when we take on a project, we see the opportunity to make a lasting connection with the people and places where we live and work.
How to apply
If you are an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident and this position is of interest, your application can be submitted online.
No Agency CV’s will be accepted.

This is an environment where your contribution will be recognised, your technical development encouraged and your career progression supported.

Who we are
The City of Salisbury is the most progressive council in South Australia, driving growth, jobs, housing and opportunity in the north. With a workforce of over 400 people, we offer the chance to collaborate with teams across the organisation to deliver meaningful, community-focused projects.
The City Infrastructure Department delivers asset management, capital works, and maintenance programs, as well as oversees lease management for local community and sporting clubs, and security and civil compliance functions.
Join us and see the positive impact your work can make.
About the role
The City of Salisbury is seeking three experienced Asset Engineers to join the Engineering Assets & Systems team within City Infrastructure. Opportunities are available across Civil, Roads and Drainage asset portfolios.
Reporting to the Divisional Head, Engineering Assets & Systems (Asset Engineer - Civil and Asset Engineer - Roads) or the Senior Stormwater Engineer (Asset Engineer - Drainage), you will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving asset management plans, undertaking engineering investigations and modelling, and supporting long-term infrastructure planning and investment decisions.
You will play a key role in managing and improving some of the City's most important infrastructure assets, including roads, drainage networks, wetlands, bridges, boardwalks, coastal assets, carparks, signage and stormwater infrastructure, helping ensure they continue to meet the needs of our growing community.
Your key responsibilities will include
- Develop, maintain and improve Asset Management Plans across a range of infrastructure asset classes.
- Undertake engineering investigations, modelling, analysis and reporting to support asset management decisions.
- Develop capital renewal, maintenance and lifecycle programs.
- Assess asset condition, risk, service levels and long-term investment priorities.
- Prepare project briefs and business cases for infrastructure projects and renewal programs.
- Evaluate consultant reports, designs and technical proposals.
- Provide specialist engineering and asset management advice across the organisation.
- Support planning for future growth and infrastructure needs across the city.
- Build and maintain effective working relationships with community members, developers, government agencies, service authorities and internal stakeholders.
- Communicate technical information and asset management recommendations clearly to a diverse range of stakeholders, including residents, elected members and senior leaders.
- Respond to enquiries from residents, elected members and other stakeholders.
About you
You are a qualified engineer with experience in infrastructure asset management and a passion for delivering practical, long-term outcomes for communities. You combine strong technical capability with excellent communication skills and can confidently engage with a wide range of stakeholders. You are able to translate complex engineering and asset management information into clear, practical advice that supports informed decision-making.
You will also have
- Degree qualifications in Civil Engineering, equivalent qualifications, or proven extensive experience in asset management relating to civil infrastructure and stormwater.
- Experience in infrastructure asset management, planning and lifecycle analysis.
- Knowledge of asset management frameworks such as ISO 55000 and IIMM/IPWEA practices.
- Experience using asset management, GIS and engineering modelling systems.
- Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Proven experience building productive relationships with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders.
- Strong written communication skills, including the preparation of reports, business cases and technical documentation.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Current driver's licence.
Desirable
- Postgraduate qualifications in asset management.
- Experience working within local government.
What we offer
- State-of-the-art Salisbury Community Hub is 25 minutes from the CBD with excellent rail and road connections.
- Modern and positive work environments.
- Free car parking.
- Flexible work options.
- Three additional leave days per year.
- Annual pay rises.
- Health and wellbeing programs, including skin checks, health assessments, flu vaccinations and an employee assistance program.
- Professional development opportunities.

About the Role
PCP Solutions is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Graduate Civil Engineer to join our growing team.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent engineering graduate or someone in the early stages of their career to gain valuable hands-on experience working on large-scale civil infrastructure projects.
Working alongside experienced Project Managers, Site Engineers and Supervisors, you will assist with the planning, coordination, quality assurance and delivery of civil construction works from commencement through to completion.
The successful applicant will be provided with ongoing guidance and support while developing their technical knowledge, project management skills and practical understanding of civil construction operations.
The Company
PCP Solutions is a leading civil earthworks and commercial plumbing business based in Toowoomba, delivering projects across South East Queensland.
With over 70 staff, PCP Solutions specialises in large-scale infrastructure works for Tier 1 contractors whilst maintaining a supportive, family-focused culture.
We pride ourselves on delivering quality projects, building strong working relationships and providing opportunities for our employees to grow and develop within the business.
Key Responsibilities
Working under the guidance of senior project personnel, your responsibilities will include:
- Assist with daily site inspections and monitoring construction activities.
- Prepare, maintain and complete Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and associated quality assurance documentation.
- Assist with the preparation and submission of project reports and documentation to Principal Contractors.
- Support daily work front reporting, progress tracking and construction records.
- Assist with project programming, scheduling and monitoring critical deadlines.
- Provide project administration and engineering support to Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors and Quality and Safety personnel.
- Assist with reviewing construction drawings, specifications and technical documentation.
- Monitor supplier material conformance and ensure materials meet project specifications.
- Assist with quantity calculations, material take-offs and procurement requirements.
- Support the implementation and maintenance of project quality, workplace health and safety and environmental controls.
- Assist with identifying and reporting potential project risks, delays and construction issues.
- Maintain accurate project records, filing systems and document control processes.
- Provide regular project progress updates to the Project Manager and wider project team.
- Ensure compliance with the company's Integrated Management System (IMS), policies and procedures.
Skills and Qualifications
We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, takes initiative and is passionate about developing a career in civil construction.
The successful applicant will ideally possess:
- A completed Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
- Recent graduates and applicants with up to 2 years of industry experience are encouraged to apply.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work professionally with clients, suppliers, subcontractors and site personnel.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate documentation.
- A willingness to learn and develop practical construction and project management skills.
- Basic understanding of civil construction methods, engineering drawings and specifications.
- Sound computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
- Ability to work independently when required and contribute positively to a team environment.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong commitment to workplace safety.
- A current driver's licence and Construction White Card, or willingness to obtain a White Card prior to commencing.
- Willingness to travel to regional project locations as required.
Previous experience in civil construction, earthworks, water infrastructure or quality assurance will be highly regarded but is not essential.
What We Offer
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience on major civil infrastructure projects.
- Mentoring and ongoing support from experienced engineering and construction professionals.
- Exposure to Tier 1 construction projects and industry-leading systems.
- Career development and progression opportunities within a growing company.
- A supportive, family-focused team environment.
- Competitive remuneration based on qualifications and experience.
- A diverse role offering both site-based and project administration experience.
How to Apply
If you are a motivated Graduate Civil Engineer looking to kick-start your career and gain practical experience in the civil construction industry, we would love to hear from you.
Apply via SEEK or email your resume and cover letter to admin@pcpsolutions.com.au
Join PCP Solutions and build your engineering career with a team committed to quality, safety and delivering successful projects.

Company Description
Who Are CPP? 
CPP is a leading high-voltage infrastructure provider, connecting renewable energy projects to Australia’s electricity grid.
As a member of Quanta Services, a Fortune 500 company ranked #157 on the NYSX, we specialise in the design, construction, commissioning, and maintenance of substations, transmission lines, wind farms, and battery storage systems.
Established in 1996, we’ve connected more wind farms and renewable batteries than any other company. With over 850 employees and offices in Adelaide, Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane and Perth, we partner with Australia’s major transmission providers to deliver innovative, end-to-end solutions.
Join us in shaping the future of energy.
Job Description
CPP has the largest in-house design and engineering team of any contractor in Australia, with over 170 specialists across Electrical Primary and Secondary, Civil, Structural, and SCADA disciplines. We provide end-to-end engineering solutions for high-voltage infrastructure, including nationally significant transmission projects, HV substations, wind farms and battery storage systems that drive Australia’s renewable energy transition.
Our engineers work closely with construction and operations teams, ensuring designs are practical, constructible, and continually refined through real-world feedback. With a commitment to innovation and excellence, we deliver solutions that support a stable, reliable, and sustainable energy future.
The Opportunity 
CPP are seeking an experienced Drafter - Civil to join our collaborative, national in-house design team. If you're passionate about creating accurate, buildable civil designs for real-world infrastructure projects, this is your chance to make a meaningful and visible impact on Australia’s energy future.
In this role, you’ll be responsible for producing high-quality, practical design drawings for high-voltage and renewable infrastructure projects across the country. You’ll work closely with civil engineers to interpret design concepts and transform them into constructible, compliant design packages.
This is a hands-on drafting role where your attention to detail and technical expertise will directly influence the success of major energy projects. You’ll use software such as AutoCAD and Microstation to deliver clear, well-structured documentation that supports construction teams on site.
Qualifications
To be successful in this role, you will possess:
- Drafting experience (3+ years) in civil design drafting
- Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Microstation
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to produce clear, accurate, and well-structured documentation
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to project delivery
Additional Information
At CPP, we value our people above all else. We’re dedicated to investing in and developing your talent to help you reach your full potential. By joining us, you’ll have the opportunity to work on industry-leading projects and access the latest technologies. With a strong history of providing clear career progression, we promote from within, offering pathways from Engineer, to Senior, Principal, leadership positions and beyond.
Benefits include:
- Above-market salary package with annual reviews
- Annual bonus, discretionary based on individual and business performance
- We offer flexible working options, with the ability to work from home
- Access to study assistance for continuous development, and a strong focus on internal promotions to help you grow within
- 16 weeks paid primary parental leave and 6 weeks paid secondary parental leave
- Up to 2 weeks of purchased leave
- Enjoy a range of salary packaging benefits, including novated leases, airport lounge memberships and exclusive Qantas Club offers.
- Choice between an iPhone or Samsung mobile & design specked engineering laptop and software
- Generous employee referral program up to $4,000
- We actively invest in AI capability, providing access to premium AI subscriptions to help you work smarter, solve complex problems and deliver better outcomes
- Access to an extensive benefits and discounts program with savings at over 400 retailers
- Free Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, supporting physical, mental, and financial wellbeing
How to Apply:
To submit an application please upload your resume via the links provided.
For further information, please reach out to amoritz@conpower.com.au however applications will not be accepted via email.
CPP is an equal opportunity employer that fosters a culture of achievement, personal development and offers a diverse, safe and supportive work environment.

With over 430 employees, we’re one of Australia’s largest employee-owned property and infrastructure consultancies, bringing over 40 years of experience and local expertise to projects across Melbourne, Bendigo, Brisbane, Adelaide, Canberra, Geelong, Ballarat, Shepparton, Gippsland, Albury and Wodonga, and Townsville.

No matter how you say it, we’re glad you’re here!
Build your civil career in Townsville
We’re looking for a Civil Designer to join our growing Townsville team and contribute to the design and delivery of urban development and civil infrastructure projects.
You’ll bring experience in urban development civil engineering design, with an interest in working across the different elements of land development. From roads and drainage to earthworks and servicing, you’ll help develop practical, coordinated designs that support projects from concept through to detailed documentation and delivery.
Working closely with our local team and supported by Spiire’s broader network, you’ll take responsibility for work that reflects your experience and strengths. You’ll bring:

You’ll work closely with experienced local colleagues while drawing on the technical expertise and support of our broader network. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to broaden your project experience, take on responsibility and develop your career in a direction that suits your strengths.
Whether you’re already based in Townsville or looking to make the region your home, we’d love to hear from you.
Our Culture, Our Difference
At Spiire, we believe our culture is our difference. As a successful and growing employee-owned business, we recognise and reward the contributions of our people and provide real opportunities and pathways for career progression.

Company Overview
Noble Built is an Adelaide-based residential construction and property development company specialising in custom home design and construction, residential property development, knockdown and rebuild projects, land subdivision and investment builds. The Company provides comprehensive project services, from initial feasibility assessments, design and council approvals through to construction and final handover. With a focus on quality workmanship, functional design, cost-effective solutions and effective project delivery, Noble Built works with homeowners, landowners and investors to deliver tailored residential projects across Adelaide, South Australia.
About the role
Noble Built is seeking a skilled and experienced Civil Engineering Draftsperson to join our team in Adelaide, South Australia. The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing, developing and modifying detailed civil engineering drawings and technical documentation for residential construction and property development projects. Working closely with project management team, the role will involve preparing engineering drawings based on design requirements and technical specifications, incorporating drawing revisions and ensuring documentation complies with relevant Australian Standards, building codes and local council requirements. This position will play an important role in supporting the preparation of civil engineering documentation and the delivery of the Company's residential projects.
Key Responsibilities
1.           Assisting civil engineer and project supervisor in preparing civil engineering drawings and technical documentation for residential construction, property development and land subdivision projects.
2.           Preparing detailed civil engineering drawings for site layouts, earthworks, site grading, stormwater drainage, sewerage, water supply and associated civil infrastructure works.
3.           Preparing, developing and modifying engineering drawings, sketches and plans in accordance with engineering designs, technical specifications and project requirements.
4.           Preparing technical specifications, drawing schedules and supporting documentation for civil engineering works.
5.           Reviewing survey plans, site measurements and engineering information to ensure the accuracy and completeness of civil engineering drawings.
6.           Using computer-aided design software, including AutoCAD and Civil 3D, to produce, update and revise detailed engineering drawings.
7.           Conducting site inspections, where required, to verify site conditions and identify discrepancies between engineering drawings and actual site conditions.
8.           Liaising with civil engineer and project supervisor regarding technical drawings, design revisions and construction requirements.
About You
- Diploma or higher qualification in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Drafting, or a related field.
- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a Civil Engineering Draftsperson, preferably within the residential construction or property development industry.
- Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
- Experience with Revit is an advantage.
- Sound knowledge of civil engineering drawings, technical specifications, site layouts, earthworks, stormwater drainage and other civil infrastructure works.
- Ability to interpret engineering drawings, survey plans and technical documentation, and prepare accurate and detailed civil engineering drawings.
- Strong attention to detail, with good analytical, problem-solving and time management skills.
- Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to liaise with engineers, construction personnel, subcontractors and project managers.
Why Join US
Opportunity to work on a diverse range of residential construction and property development projects across Adelaide.
Gain exposure to different stages of residential development, from initial planning and design documentation through to construction.
Work closely with experienced engineer professionals and project management teams.
Develop your technical drafting skills and industry knowledge through hands-on project experience.
Join a collaborative team that values technical accuracy, quality workmanship and professional development.
Be part of a growing business with ongoing residential construction and development projects.

Our Culture
We pride ourselves on a positive working culture and a clear vision, mission and goals. We are a truly multicultural team with a merit-based approach: people are recognised and rewarded for their performance and talent, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, age or background.
The Role: CMT Field Technician
We’re looking for a motivated, self-driven and experienced Field Technician who is comfortable with computers. You’ll be involved in every stage of the RG-CMTL’s work, from field operations through to laboratory testing and project management.
Benefits
- Full-time, permanent position
- Above-market salary of $80,000–$90,000 + super, depending on experience
- Company car, including fuel and tolls
- Laptop, tools and phone allowance
- Clear pathways for career progression
Essential Requirements
- Australian citizenship, permanent residency, or a visa with full, unrestricted work rights (sorry, we cannot consider student visa holders)
- Diploma or higher in Civil Engineering, Laboratory Technology or a related discipline
- At least 1 to 2 years’ CMT experience covering both field and laboratory work (NSW experience preferred)
- Current NSW EPA Radiation User Licence, with proven experience operating Nuclear Density Gauges
- Working knowledge of the relevant Australian Standards, including compaction, CBR and concrete testing

candidates.content_text:
At Aurecon, we are engineering optimists who see the world differently. We ask what's possible and turn ideas into impact. Here, you'll bring your expertise to challenges that matter, alongside people who think boldly and are determined to make a difference.
What you'll do
We are seeking a Civil Engineer to join our Buildings Civil team in Adelaide. This is a fantastic opportunity to work alongside experienced specialists and contribute to a diverse range of projects across the health, education, defence, civic, commercial and community sectors.
As a Civil Engineer, you'll support the delivery of civil engineering design across a range of multidisciplinary projects. You'll work closely with senior engineers, designers and project teams to develop practical, sustainable and innovative solutions while continuing to build your technical capabilities and professional experience. That is why we are here - to bring ideas to life, the Aurecon way.

candidates.title: Civil Engineer - Land Development - CPEng
candidates.abstract:
Civil Engineer - CPEng
Take ownership of meaningful land development projects within a technically focused, supportive engineering consultancy.
bullets: $135K – $165K + Super - Sydney - Multidisciplinary Engineering Consultancy.
CPEng required + TUFLOW experience highly regarded.
Genuine flexibility, hybrid working and a relaxed, collaborative team culture.
candidates.content_text:
About the Company:
Representing an established multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, I am looking to introduce a Civil Engineer to a team with a strong presence across the consulting engineering and built environment sectors.
The business has built its reputation around technical capability, quality project delivery and strong working relationships. It is a practice where engineers are encouraged to contribute, take ownership of their work and collaborate directly with experienced colleagues rather than simply becoming another number in a large organisation.
The culture is down to earth, with a genuine emphasis on supporting the people around you, enjoying the work and creating an environment where good engineers can do their best work.
The Opportunity:
An opportunity is available for a Civil Engineer with a background in land development to join the Sydney team.
The preference is for a Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) who is comfortable taking technical ownership of civil design and contributing to the delivery of development projects across NSW.
You will work across the civil engineering design process, with exposure to stormwater management, drainage, earthworks and associated infrastructure. The role offers the opportunity to contribute technically, work alongside experienced engineers and have a genuine influence on project outcomes.
While CPEng accreditation is strongly preferred, the business is also open to considering experienced intermediate engineers with relevant land development experience who are progressing towards chartership and greater technical responsibility.
Experience with TUFLOW modelling would be particularly advantageous.
What You Will Be Doing:
- Undertaking civil engineering design across a range of land development projects.
- Developing civil design solutions for stormwater drainage, earthworks, roads and associated infrastructure.
- Undertaking hydraulic and hydrological modelling, including stormwater management and flood assessments.
- Preparing engineering calculations, technical reports, design documentation and supporting approval submissions.
- Coordinating with internal engineering disciplines, external consultants, clients and relevant authorities.
- Applying relevant Australian Standards, council requirements and engineering guidelines throughout the design process.
- Contributing to design reviews, technical discussions and the overall delivery of projects.
What We Are Looking For:
- A degree in Civil Engineering.
- CPEng accreditation strongly preferred, with consideration given to experienced engineers progressing towards chartership.
- A minimum of 5+ years’ experience within civil engineering consultancy, ideally with 3+ years in the land development sector.
- Sound understanding of civil design principles, stormwater management and drainage design.
- Experience using 12d and/or Civil 3D expected.
- Working knowledge of DRAINS and MUSIC is desirable.
- TUFLOW modelling experience would be highly regarded.
- The ability to work collaboratively, communicate technical information and take ownership of your work.
What's On Offer:
- $135,000 – $165,000 + Super, depending on experience and capability.
- The business offers a working environment with plenty to like:
- Flexible working: Hybrid arrangements and flexible start and finish times.
- A supportive team: Work alongside experienced engineers in an approachable, collaborative environment.
- A relaxed culture: A professional workplace without unnecessary corporate formalities.
- Team connection: Regular social activities and company events throughout the year.
- Professional development: Opportunities to broaden your technical experience and contribute to increasingly complex projects.
Importantly, flexibility is not just something written into a policy. The business is happy to have a genuine conversation about what works for you.
About Me:
I'm David Hamilton, a Registered Architect who has transitioned into specialist recruitment across the architecture, engineering and construction industries.
Having worked within the built environment myself, I understand the technical nature of these roles and appreciate that choosing the right next move is about considerably more than a job title or salary.
My approach is straightforward. I take the time to understand both the opportunity and the individual, ensuring there is a genuine alignment between the two.
Apply:
If you are a Civil Engineer with land development experience and are interested in exploring an opportunity with a technically focused, supportive and flexible consultancy, I would welcome a confidential conversation.
Click APPLY or send your CV in Word format to david@salexo.com.au.
For a confidential discussion, call me on (02) 9922 9622.
*All applications and enquiries will be treated in the strictest confidence.
